product_metadata.title: Furinno 12285IV Non-Woven Fabric Storage Organizer, 3 by 5-Inch, Ivory with Brown Trim
features: Ideal storage box for neatly classify small articles, bra, underwear, socks, necktie, accessories, etc.
Made of non-woven polypropylene and paperboard
Easy fold flat when not in use; come in multiple divider options, 8 cells, 12 cell and 24cell
It is soft and lightweight yet durable and convenience to use
Fits perfectly under bed, closet shelf and drawer
description: FURINNO Non-Woven Fabric Soft Storage Organizer make the best storage and organizing needs in your room. Simple and convenient design perfect to organize your drawer space neatly and easily accessible. They are household alike, foldable, convenient and durable. FURINNO thinks of ways to fit in your space and fit on your budget. These foldable bins are also perfect for organizing arts and crafts material as well as sewing and knitting materials. Use these storage organizer to make your home project more convenience by keeping things in place.
